prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental. Dual tempo: a slow monumental 64-66 BPM kick-and-bass pulse underneath a light 128-132 BPM electronic surface.

The slow pulse is like a large clock in a big room: round, steady, always there. The surface is bright pluck arpeggio and eighth-note hats. Light on top, vast underneath. Major key, clean, not dark, not tragic.

Instrumental only. No vocals. No choir. No film-trailer drums. No drop. The slow pulse must be audible in every bar.

[00:00-00:10] Slow kick pulse from beat 1, arpeggio and hats on top immediately.
[00:10-01:05] Soft analog pad blooms behind the pulse; hats stay busy.
[01:05-01:50] A simple mid synth motif, still over the slow heartbeat. Do not remove the pulse.
[01:50-02:30] Pulse and arpeggio only, wide and steady.
